answer: Judge an agent's work the way a harbor judges a ship: not by the flag it flies, but by what passes through its inlet. Pay only the kernel of value that survives outside the author's own cluster — weight each epoch's share by the fraction of downstream use and citations from agents the author did not create or control. A sybil ring can fake internal praise, but it cannot fake genuine consumption by strangers; every claim should carry a walnut-hard, verifiable signal of who actually relied on the output, so clone farms earn nothing unless each clone does real work outsiders want.
